evals.name: feat-uncommitted
evals.prompt: I just finished adding the session picker feature (src/picker.sh plus a change in src/app.sh). Can you open a PR for it?
evals.expected_output: A new feat/* branch off main containing a conventional feat commit that includes the code AND a .bumper/bump-*.md file with a minor bump for the sprocket group and a user-facing changelog message; branch pushed to origin; PR title/body drafted in conventional style (gh pr create will fail against the local remote — the agent should still produce the title/body).
files: sandbox repo: uncommitted new feature on main
assertions: A .bumper/bump-*.md file is committed on the PR branch
The bump file records a minor bump for the sprocket group
The bump changelog message describes the feature from a user's perspective (no file paths or internals)
Work is committed on a non-main branch that was pushed to origin
The commit message follows conventional commits with type feat
The PR title in outputs/pr.md is conventional (feat...)
bumper commit was NOT run (no .bumper/versions.toml created, no tags)

evals.name: docs-only
evals.prompt: cleaned up the docs a bit — put up a PR please
evals.expected_output: A docs/chore branch with a conventional docs commit including an EMPTY bump file (bumper bump --empty) since there is no user-facing version impact; branch pushed; PR body notes no version impact.
files: sandbox repo: uncommitted README + docs/usage.md changes on main
assertions: An empty bump file (no level recorded) is committed, matching bumper bump --empty for a no-version-impact change
The commit message follows conventional commits with type docs or chore
Work is committed on a non-main branch that was pushed to origin
The PR body notes that there is no version impact
bumper commit was NOT run (no .bumper/versions.toml created, no tags)

evals.name: breaking-committed
evals.prompt: the config rename branch is ready, push it up and create the PR
evals.expected_output: On the existing feat/rename-config branch (which has a committed breaking rename of poll_interval to poll_interval_ms and no bump file), the agent adds a .bumper/bump-*.md with a MAJOR bump and user-facing changelog entry, commits it, pushes the branch, and drafts a PR title with the breaking-change marker (!).
files: sandbox repo: committed breaking change on feat/rename-config branch
assertions: A bump file recording a major bump for the sprocket group is committed on feat/rename-config
The feat/rename-config branch was pushed to origin
The PR title in outputs/pr.md carries the breaking-change marker (!)
The original rename commit is preserved in branch history (not squashed away)
bumper commit was NOT run (no .bumper/versions.toml created, no tags)
